objective: Assess whether the existing RTX 5070 Ti appliance has sufficient resources for Work Entry 009 and documented model workloads, without running a benchmark or changing capacity.
governing_standards: compute-cp guest compute and training contracts

authority.source: Louis's 2026-10-01 RTX 5070 Ti execution-host resource assessment instruction
granted: Read existing public resource, telemetry and benchmark evidence
Register Work Entry 010 and prepare an assessment and measurement packet
explicitly_not_granted: Run a GPU workload, benchmark or stress test
Install software or reallocate CPU, RAM, storage, passthrough or VM resources
Purchase hardware or change live configuration
Publish or merge this preparation branch

isolation.reason: The primary checkout contains preserved work and the assessment must remain separate from branch-to-main cleanup.

dependencies.description: Work Entry 009 defines the only new workload whose measurements may be collected for this assessment.
Existing accepted model and runtime profiles provide historical measured demand.
Current CPU, RAM, swap, storage and PCIe link measurements remain unobserved and are delegated to the future Work Entry 009 run packet.
dependencies.owner: compute-cp and gpu-cp under Louis authorization

expected_validation: Validate this work entry against work-entry-v1
Run the focused work-protocol tests and full repo-cp validation
Check JSON, Python and whitespace syntax

allowed: Add Work Entry 010 topology, capacity-assessment and measurement-packet records in the isolated repo-cp checkout
prohibited: Any live benchmark, stress, host, guest, GPU, model, adapter, credential or service operation
Any resource purchase, publication or merge

required_evidence: A capacity table separating GPU, CPU, RAM, storage, PCIe and software constraints
Measured evidence distinguished from estimates and unknowns
A scoped sufficiency conclusion and no-purchase decision unless evidence supports otherwise
One coordinated measurement packet for unresolved current facts
